discoveries.name: CVE-2020-29583 · Zyxel Multiple Products
discoveries.signal: Zyxel firewalls (ATP, USG, VM) and AP Controllers (NXC2500 and NXC5500) contain a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability in an undocumented account ("zyfwp") with an unchangeable password.

discoveries.name: CVE-2019-8394 · Zoho ManageEngine
discoveries.signal: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote users to upload files via login page customization.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-10189 · Zoho ManageEngine
discoveries.signal: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central contains a file upload vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

discoveries.name: CVE-2021-40539 · Zoho ManageEngine
discoveries.signal: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus contains an authentication bypass vulnerability affecting the REST API URLs which allow for remote code execution.

discoveries.name: CVE-2021-27561 · Yealink Device Management
discoveries.signal: Yealink Device Management contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

discoveries.name: CVE-2019-9978 · WordPress Social Warfare Plugin
discoveries.signal: WordPress Social Warfare plugin contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability affects Social Warfare and Social Warfare Pro.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-11738 · WordPress Snap Creek Duplicator Plugin
discoveries.signal: WordPress Snap Creek Duplicator plugin contains a file download vulnerability when an administrator creates a new copy of their site that allows an attacker to download the generated files from their Wordpress dashboard. This vulnerability affects Duplicator and Dulplicator Pro.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-25213 · WordPress File Manager Plugin
discoveries.signal: WordPress File Manager plugin contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to execute PHP code and upload malicious files on a target site.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-4006 · VMware Multiple Products
discoveries.signal: VMware Workspace One Access, Access Connector, Identity Manager, and Identity Manager Connector contain a command injection vulnerability. An attacker with network access to the administrative configurator on port 8443 and a valid password for the configurator administrator account can execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system.

discoveries.name: CVE-2021-21985 · VMware vCenter Server
discoveries.signal: VMware vSphere Client contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Virtual SAN Health Check plug-in, which is enabled by default in vCenter Server, which allows for remote code execution.

discoveries.name: CVE-2021-21972 · VMware vCenter Server
discoveries.signal: VMware vCenter Server vSphere Client contains a remote code execution vulnerability in a vCenter Server plugin which allows an attacker with network access to port 443 to execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-3952 · VMware vCenter Server
discoveries.signal: VMware vCenter Server contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service (vmdir) when the Platform Services Controller (PSC) does not correctly implement access controls. Successful exploitation allows an attacker with network access to port 389 to extract sensitive information.

discoveries.name: CVE-2021-22005 · VMware vCenter Server
discoveries.signal: VMware vCenter Server contains a file upload vulnerability in the Analytics service that allows a user with network access to port 443 to execute code.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-3950 · VMware Multiple Products
discoveries.signal: VMware Fusion, Remote Console (VMRC) for Mac, and Horizon Client for Mac contain a privilege escalation vulnerability due to improper use of setuid binaries that allows attackers to escalate privileges to root.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-3992 · VMware ESXi
discoveries.signal: VMware ESXi OpenSLP contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an attacker residing in the management network with access to port 427 to perform remote code execution.

discoveries.name: CVE-2019-5544 · VMware VMware ESXi and Horizon DaaS
discoveries.signal: VMware ESXi and Horizon Desktop as a Service (DaaS) OpenSLP contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker with network access to port 427 to overwrite the heap of the OpenSLP service to perform remote code execution.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-17496 · vBulletin vBulletin
discoveries.signal: The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via crafted subWidgets data in an ajax/render/widget_tabbedcontainer_tab_panel request. This CVE ID resolves an incomplete patch for CVE-2019-16759.

discoveries.name: CVE-2019-16759 · vBulletin vBulletin
discoveries.signal: The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via the widgetConfig[code] parameter in an ajax/render/widget_php routestring request.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-5847 · Unraid Unraid
discoveries.signal: Unraid contains a vulnerability due to the insecure use of the extract PHP function that can be abused to execute remote code as root. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5849 for initial access.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-5849 · Unraid Unraid
discoveries.signal: Unraid contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to gain access to the administrative interface. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5847 for remote code execution.

discoveries.name: CVE-2019-20085 · TVT NVMS-1000
discoveries.signal: TVT devices utilizing NVMS-1000 software contain a directory traversal vulnerability via GET /.. requests.

discoveries.name: CVE-2021-36741 · Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security
discoveries.signal: Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security contain an improper input validation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to upload files.

discoveries.name: CVE-2021-36742 · Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security
discoveries.signal: Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security contain an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-8599 · Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan
discoveries.signal: Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan server contain a vulnerable EXE file that could allow a remote attacker to write data to a path on affected installations and bypass root login.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-24557 · Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security
discoveries.signal: Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security on Microsoft Windows contain an improper access control vulnerability that may allow an attacker to manipulate a particular product folder to disable the security temporarily, abuse a specific Windows function, and attain privilege escalation.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-8468 · Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan and Worry-Free Business Security Agents
discoveries.signal: Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security agents contain a content validation escape vulnerability that could allow an attacker to manipulate certain agent client components.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-8467 · Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan
discoveries.signal: Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan contain an unspecified vulnerability within a migration tool component that allows for remote code execution.

discoveries.name: CVE-2019-18187 · Trend Micro OfficeScan
discoveries.signal: Trend Micro OfficeScan contains a directory traversal vulnerability by extracting files from a zip file to a specific folder on the OfficeScan server, leading to remote code execution.

discoveries.name: CVE-2019-9082 · ThinkPHP ThinkPHP
discoveries.signal: ThinkPHP contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via public//?s=index/\think\app/invokefunction&function=call_user_func_array&vars[0]=system&vars[1][]= followed by the command.

discoveries.name: CVE-2018-20062 · ThinkPHP noneCms
discoveries.signal: ThinkPHP "noneCms" contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution through crafted use of the filter parameter.

discoveries.name: CVE-2018-14558 · Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 Routers
discoveries.signal: Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 devices contain a command injection vulnerability due to  the "formsetUsbUnload" function executes a dosystemCmd function with untrusted input. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute OS commands via a crafted goform/setUsbUnload request.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-10987 · Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model
discoveries.signal: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute system commands via the deviceName POST parameter.

discoveries.name: CVE-2021-31755 · Tenda AC11 Router
discoveries.signal: Tenda AC11 devices contain a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in /goform/setmac which allows attackers to execute code via a crafted post request.

discoveries.name: CVE-2017-9248 · Progress ASP.NET AJAX and Sitefinity
discoveries.signal: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX and Sitefinity have a cryptographic weakness in Telerik.Web.UI.dll that can be exploited to disclose encryption keys (Telerik.Web.UI.DialogParametersEncryptionKey and/or the MachineKey), perform cross-site-scripting (XSS) attacks, compromise the ASP.NET ViewState, and/or upload and download files.

discoveries.name: CVE-2019-18988 · TeamViewer Desktop
discoveries.signal: TeamViewer Desktop allows for bypass of remote-login access control because the same AES key is used for different customers' installations. If an attacker were to know this key, they could decrypt protected information stored in registry or configuration files or decryption of the Unattended Access password to the system (which allows for remote login to the system).

discoveries.name: CVE-2017-6327 · Symantec Symantec Messaging Gateway
discoveries.signal: Symantec Messaging Gateway contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution. With the ability to perform remote code execution, an attacker may also desire to perform privilege escalating actions.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-10181 · Sumavision Enhanced Multimedia Router (EMR)
discoveries.signal: Sumavision Enhanced Multimedia Router (EMR) contains a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability allowing the creation of users with elevated privileges as administrator on a device.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-12271 · Sophos SFOS
discoveries.signal: Sophos Firewall operating system (SFOS) firmware contains a SQL injection vulnerability when configured with either the administration (HTTPS) service or the User Portal is exposed on the WAN zone. Successful exploitation may cause remote code execution to exfiltrate usernames and hashed passwords for the local device admin(s), portal admins, and user accounts used for remote access (but not external Active Directory or LDAP passwords).

discoveries.name: CVE-2021-20016 · SonicWall SSLVPN SMA100
discoveries.signal: SonicWall SSLVPN SMA100 contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows remote exploitation for credential access by an unauthenticated attacker.

discoveries.name: CVE-2021-20023 · SonicWall SonicWall Email Security
discoveries.signal: SonicWall Email Security contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows a post-authenticated attacker to read files on the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20021 and CVE-2021-20022 to achieve privilege escalation.

discoveries.name: CVE-2021-20022 · SonicWall SonicWall Email Security
discoveries.signal: SonicWall Email Security contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows a post-authenticated attacker to upload a file to the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20021 and CVE-2021-20023 to achieve privilege escalation.

discoveries.name: CVE-2019-7481 · SonicWall SMA100
discoveries.signal: SonicWall SMA100 contains a SQL injection vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated user to gain read-only access to unauthorized resources.

discoveries.name: CVE-2021-20021 · SonicWall SonicWall Email Security
discoveries.signal: SonicWall Email Security contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows an attacker to create an administrative account by sending a crafted HTTP request to the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20022 and CVE-2021-20023 to achieve privilege escalation.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-10199 · Sonatype Nexus Repository
discoveries.signal: Sonatype Nexus Repository contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

discoveries.name: CVE-2016-3643 · SolarWinds Virtualization Manager
discoveries.signal: SolarWinds Virtualization Manager allows for privilege escalation through leveraging a misconfiguration of sudo.

discoveries.name: CVE-2021-35211 · SolarWinds Serv-U
discoveries.signal: SolarWinds Serv-U contains an unspecified memory escape vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-10148 · SolarWinds Orion
discoveries.signal: SolarWinds Orion API contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute API commands.

discoveries.name: CVE-2019-16256 · SIMalliance Toolbox Browser
discoveries.signal: SIMalliance Toolbox Browser contains an command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to retrieve location and IMEI information or execute a range of other attacks by modifying the attack message.

discoveries.name: CVE-2016-3976 · SAP NetWeaver
discoveries.signal: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains a directory traversal vulnerability via a ..\ (dot dot backslash) in the fileName parameter to CrashFileDownloadServlet. This allows remote attackers to read files.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-6207 · SAP Solution Manager
discoveries.signal: SAP Solution Manager User Experience Monitoring contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which results in complete compromise of all SMDAgents connected to the Solution Manager.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-6287 · SAP NetWeaver
discoveries.signal: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability allowing unauthenticated access to execute configuration tasks and create administrative users.

discoveries.name: CVE-2016-9563 · SAP NetWeaver
discoveries.signal: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains an unspecified vulnerability in BC-BMT-BPM-DSK which allows remote, authenticated users to conduct XML External Entity (XXE) attacks.

discoveries.name: CVE-2010-5326 · SAP NetWeaver
discoveries.signal: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms Invoker Servlet does not require authentication, allowing for remote code execution via a HTTP or HTTPS request.

discoveries.name: CVE-2018-2380 · SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
discoveries.signal: SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to exploit insufficient validation of path information provided by users.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-16846 · SaltStack Salt
discoveries.signal: SaltStack Salt allows an unauthenticated user with network access to the Salt API to use shell injections to run code on the Salt API using the SSH client. This vulnerability affects any users running the Salt API.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-11651 · SaltStack Salt
discoveries.signal: SaltStack Salt contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the salt-master process ClearFuncs due to improperly validating method calls. The vulnerability allows a remote user to access some methods without authentication, which can be used to retrieve user tokens from the salt master and/or run commands on salt minions. Salt users who follow fundamental internet security guidelines and best practices are not affected by this vulnerability.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-11652 · SaltStack Salt
discoveries.signal: SaltStack Salt contains a path traversal vulnerability in the salt-master process ClearFuncs which allows directory access to authenticated users. Salt users who follow fundamental internet security guidelines and best practices are not affected by this vulnerability.

discoveries.name: CVE-2017-16651 · Roundcube Roundcube Webmail
discoveries.signal: Roundcube Webmail contains a file disclosure vulnerability caused by insufficient input validation in conjunction with file-based attachment plugins, which are used by default.

discoveries.name: CVE-2021-35395 · Realtek AP-Router SDK
discoveries.signal: Realtek AP-Router SDK HTTP web server boa contains a buffer overflow vulnerability due to unsafe copies of some overly long parameters submitted in the form that lead to denial-of-service (DoS).

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-10221 · rConfig rConfig
discoveries.signal: rConfig lib/ajaxHandlers/ajaxAddTemplate.php contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute OS commands via shell metacharacters in the fileName POST parameter.

discoveries.name: CVE-2021-1905 · Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets
discoveries.signal: Multiple Qualcomm Chipsets contain a use after free vulnerability due to improper handling of memory mapping of multiple processes simultaneously.

discoveries.name: CVE-2021-1906 · Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets
discoveries.signal: Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain a detection of error condition without action vulnerability when improper handling of address deregistration on failure can lead to new GPU address allocation failure.

discoveries.name: CVE-2019-11539 · Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure and Pulse Policy Secure
discoveries.signal: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure and Policy Secure allows an authenticated attacker from the admin web interface to inject and execute commands.

discoveries.name: CVE-2019-11510 · Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure
discoveries.signal: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker with network access via HTTPS to send a specially crafted URI.

discoveries.name: CVE-2021-22899 · Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure
discoveries.signal: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains a command injection vulnerability that allows remote authenticated users to perform remote code execution via Windows File Resource Profiles.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-8260 · Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure
discoveries.signal: Pulse Connect Secure contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an authenticated attacker to perform code execution using uncontrolled gzip extraction.

discoveries.name: CVE-2021-22894 · Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure
discoveries.signal: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Collaboration Suite contains a buffer overflow vulnerabilities that allows a remote authenticated users to execute code as the root user via maliciously crafted meeting room.

discoveries.name: CVE-2021-22900 · Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure
discoveries.signal: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability that allows an authenticated administrator to perform a file write via a maliciously crafted archive upload in the administrator web interface.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-8243 · Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure
discoveries.signal: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains an unspecified vulnerability in the admin web interface that could allow an authenticated attacker to upload a custom template to perform code execution.

discoveries.name: CVE-2021-22893 · Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure
discoveries.signal: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute code via license services.

discoveries.name: CVE-2019-18935 · Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX
discoveries.signal: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability through RadAsyncUpload which leads to code execution on the server in the context of the w3wp.exe process.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-8644 · PlaySMS PlaySMS
discoveries.signal: PlaySMS contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-14883 · Oracle WebLogic Server
discoveries.signal: Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability in the Console component with high impacts to confidentilaity, integrity, and availability.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-14882 · Oracle WebLogic Server
discoveries.signal: Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability, which is assessed to allow for remote code execution, based on this vulnerability being related to CVE-2020-14750.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-14750 · Oracle WebLogic Server
discoveries.signal: Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution. This vulnerability is related to CVE-2020-14882.

discoveries.name: CVE-2015-4852 · Oracle WebLogic Server
discoveries.signal: Oracle WebLogic Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability within Apache Commons, which can allow for for remote code execution.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-14871 · Oracle Solaris and Zettabyte File System (ZFS)
discoveries.signal: Oracle Solaris and Oracle ZFS Storage Appliance Kit contain an unspecified vulnerability causing high impacts to confidentiality, integrity, and availability of affected systems.

discoveries.name: CVE-2012-3152 · Oracle Fusion Middleware
discoveries.signal: Oracle Fusion Middleware Reports Developer contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to affect confidentiality and integrity of affected systems.

discoveries.name: CVE-2020-2555 · Oracle Multiple Products
discoveries.signal: Multiple Oracle products contain a remote code execution vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via T3 or HTTP to takeover the affected system. Impacted Oracle products: Oracle Coherence in Fusion Middleware, Oracle Utilities Framework, Oracle Retail Assortment Planning, Oracle Commerce, Oracle Communications Diameter Signaling Router (DSR).

discoveries.name: CVE-2019-19356 · Netis WF2419 Devices
discoveries.signal: Netis WF2419 devices contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform remote code execution as root through the router's web management page.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-0095
discoveries.signal: The debug command in Sendmail is enabled, allowing attackers to execute commands as root.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-0082
discoveries.signal: CWD ~root command in ftpd allows root access.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1471
discoveries.signal: Buffer overflow in passwd in BSD based operating systems 4.3 and earlier allows local users to gain root privileges by specifying a long shell or GECOS field.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1122
discoveries.signal: Vulnerability in restore in SunOS 4.0.3 and earlier allows local users to gain privileges.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1467
discoveries.signal: Vulnerability in rcp on SunOS 4.0.x allows remote attackers from trusted hosts to execute arbitrary commands as root, possibly related to the configuration of the nobody user.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1506
discoveries.signal: Vulnerability in SMI Sendmail 4.0 and earlier, on SunOS up to 4.0.3, allows remote attackers to access user bin.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-0084
discoveries.signal: Certain NFS servers allow users to use mknod to gain privileges by creating a writable kmem device and setting the UID to 0.

discoveries.name: CVE-2000-0388
discoveries.signal: Buffer overflow in FreeBSD libmytinfo library allows local users to execute commands via a long TERMCAP environmental variable.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-0209
discoveries.signal: The SunView (SunTools) selection_svc facility allows remote users to read files.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1198

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1391
discoveries.signal: Vulnerability in NeXT 1.0a and 1.0 with publicly accessible printers allows local users to gain privileges via a combination of the npd program and weak directory permissions.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1392
discoveries.signal: Vulnerability in restore0.9 installation script in NeXT 1.0a and 1.0 allows local users to gain root privileges.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1057

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1554

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1197
discoveries.signal: TIOCCONS in SunOS 4.1.1 does not properly check the permissions of a user who tries to redirect console output and input, which could allow a local user to gain privileges.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1115

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1258

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1438

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1211
discoveries.signal: Vulnerability in in.telnetd in SunOS 4.1.1 and earlier allows local users to gain root privileges.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1212
discoveries.signal: Vulnerability in in.rlogind in SunOS 4.0.3 and 4.0.3c allows local users to gain root privileges.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1194
discoveries.signal: chroot in Digital Ultrix 4.1 and 4.0 is insecurely installed, which allows local users to gain privileges.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1193
discoveries.signal: The "me" user in NeXT NeXTstep 2.1 and earlier has wheel group privileges, which could allow the me user to use the su command to become root.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1123
discoveries.signal: The installation of Sun Source (sunsrc) tapes allows local users to gain root privileges via setuid root programs (1) makeinstall or (2) winstall.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1034
discoveries.signal: Vulnerability in login in AT&T System V Release 4 allows local users to gain privileges.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1415
discoveries.signal: Vulnerability in /usr/bin/mail in DEC ULTRIX before 4.2 allows local users to gain privileges.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1090
discoveries.signal: The default configuration of NCSA Telnet package for Macintosh and PC enables FTP, even though it does not include an "ftp=yes" line, which allows remote attackers to read and modify arbitrary files.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-0498
discoveries.signal: TFTP is not running in a restricted directory, allowing a remote attacker to access sensitive information such as password files.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1468
discoveries.signal: rdist in various UNIX systems uses popen to execute sendmail, which allows local users to gain root privileges by modifying the IFS (Internal Field Separator) variable.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-0167
discoveries.signal: In SunOS, NFS file handles could be guessed, giving unauthorized access to the exported file system.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1493
discoveries.signal: Vulnerability in crp in Hewlett Packard Apollo Domain OS SR10 through SR10.3 allows remote attackers to gain root privileges via insecure system calls, (1) pad_$dm_cmd and (2) pad_$def_pfk().

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1032
discoveries.signal: Vulnerability in LAT/Telnet Gateway (lattelnet) on Ultrix 4.1 and 4.2 allows attackers to gain root privileges.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1059
discoveries.signal: Vulnerability in rexec daemon (rexecd) in AT&T TCP/IP 4.0 for various SVR4 systems allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-0627
discoveries.signal: The rexd service is running, which uses weak authentication that can allow an attacker to execute commands.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1121
discoveries.signal: The default configuration for UUCP in AIX before 3.2 allows local users to gain root privileges.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-0117
discoveries.signal: AIX passwd allows local users to gain root access.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1119
discoveries.signal: FTP installation script anon.ftp in AIX insecurely configures anonymous FTP, which allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-1142
discoveries.signal: SunOS 4.1.2 and earlier allows local users to gain privileges via "LD_*" environmental variables to certain dynamically linked setuid or setgid programs such as (1) login, (2) su, or (3) sendmail, that change the real and effective user ids to the same user.

discoveries.name: CVE-1999-0168
